newsitem.title: USA: Small plane crashes after crew, passenger pass out.
newsitem.headline: Small plane crashes after crew, passenger pass out.

text.p: A single-engine plane crashed on Friday near Alton, New Hampshire, after the pilot and a passenger both lost consciousness, officials said.

Local news reports said the teen-age girl passenger took control of the aircraft after the pilot passed out, possibly from carbon monoxide fumes. But she also passed out and the plane crashed into woods.
"The occupants on board became disabled for whatever reason," Dennis Jones, northeast regional coordinator for the National Transportation Safety Board, said.
Federal Aviation Administration spokeswoman Arlene Salac said emergency units from Alton were on their way to the scene.
"The aircraft did crash one mile north of Alton, New Hampshire, about 1338 EST," she said.
Neither Jones nor Salac had any further information about the crash.
